authority_backbone: POWO/WCVP 2026; Amarilla et al. 2013; Peterson et al. 2016
scope: Existing canonical Poaceae Munroa pulchella accepted species, historical synonyms, genus circumscription conflict and specimen/hybrid holds only

decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts the existing learner name at species rank in Poaceae; 2013 combination in Darwiniana. No canonical rename.
Homotypic basionym of the accepted species; 1816 name.
Homotypic synonym under POWO, but primary molecular treatment retained Dasyochloa as a distinct genus. Record alternative genus concept without duplicate learner.
Homotypic synonym under current POWO; old determination labels do not independently prove individual voucher identity.
Homotypic historical combination under POWO; not accepted Tridens flavus group.
Heterotypic synonym under POWO; nomenclatural mapping alone does not validate every historical specimen determination.

decisions.source_name: Proposal to create second accepted Dasyochloa pulchella species card
decisions.reason: POWO treats Dasyochloa pulchella as homotypic synonym of existing Munroa pulchella. Primary genus debate does not authorize duplicate concept.

decisions.source_name: Proposal to accept Sieglingia pulchella var. parviflora Beal as valid separate infraspecific taxon
decisions.reason: POWO lists this historical name as not validly published, within the homotypic synonym list; do not infer accepted variety.

decisions.source_name: Individual Munroa/Dasyochloa/Erioneuron source photographs and vouchers
decisions.reason: Accepted synonym mapping is not independent confirmation of individual source-determined photographs; preserve current source-level and photo verification holds.

decisions.source_name: Hybrid ancestry of any individual Munroa pulchella learner specimen
decisions.reason: No specimen-specific hybrid parentage or genetic test established in reviewed sources; do not infer hybrid status.

decisions.source_name: Genus boundary Dasyochloa versus Munroa in competing primary studies
decisions.reason: Amarilla et al. (2013) morphological phylogeny supports inclusion in Munroa; Peterson et al. (2016) molecular phylogeny supports retaining Dasyochloa as separate sister genus. POWO currently chooses Munroa; do not misrepresent debate as resolved by a single primary study.

decisions.source_name: Historical specimens labeled only fluffgrass, Erioneuron, Dasyochloa or abbreviated pulchella without adequate voucher context
decisions.reason: Nomenclatural synonymy cannot confirm a particular specimen or ambiguous shorthand label. Require complete author/source and voucher for reassignment.

limitations: POWO/WCVP currently accepts Munroa, while a 2016 primary molecular phylogeny preferred separate Dasyochloa; preserve the alternative treatment without changing the canonical name.
No individual photograph or voucher independently reidentified; source determinations remain provisional.
No hybrid ancestry established; no new hybrid or species installation.
No county nativity audit, species card enrichment, photos, genus/family lessons, Pages or schedules changed.
